entities.summary: Ablaykhan Kayratovich Zhusupov is a Kazakhstani boxer. He competed for Kazakhstan at the 2016 Summer Olympics in the men's light welterweight event. Zhusupov also represented Kazakhstan at the 2020 Summer Olympics in the men's welterweight event.
